test_merged_configs: test that merging two Habitat config YAML files produces a config with correct TASK and ENVIRONMENT values
test_new_keys_merged_configs: test that merging configs with new keys preserves both new task params and existing environment settings
test_overwrite_options: test that passing opts to get_config overwrites specific config values like MAX_EPISODE_STEPS
run_get_config: run get_config to load and merge Habitat YAML config files with optional runtime override options
review_get_config_usage: review how get_config is used to load, merge, and override Habitat simulation configuration files
